meta.name: react-component-performance
meta.description: Analyze and optimize React component performance issues (slow renders, re-render thrash, laggy lists, expensive computations). Use when asked to profile or improve a React component, reduce re-renders, or speed up UI updates in React apps.

copy.tagline: 分析并优化 React 组件渲染性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 React 应用出现渲染慢、重渲染过多或 UI 卡顿问题。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze and optimize React component rendering performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your React app suffers from slow renders, excessive re-renders, or UI lag.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析 React 组件性能问题（如渲染慢、重复渲染、列表卡顿），找出热点并给出优化建议，同时指导使用 React DevTools Profiler 验证效果。
howto.when: 当你描述 React 组件性能问题，或要求分析、优化组件、减少重渲染、加速 UI 更新时触发。

say.text: 我的列表组件滚动很卡，怎么优化？
say.note: Claude 会分析原因并给出虚拟列表、memo 等方案。

say.text: 帮我检查这个组件为什么每秒都重渲染。
say.note: Claude 会定位定时器或动画状态，建议隔离到子组件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes React component performance issues (slow renders, re-render thrash, laggy lists), identifies hotspots, suggests targeted optimizations, and guides using React DevTools Profiler to validate improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a React component performance problem, or ask to profile/optimize a component, reduce re-renders, or speed up UI updates.

say_en.text: My list component is laggy when scrolling, how to optimize?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest virtualization, memo, etc.

say_en.text: Check why this component re-renders every second.
say_en.note: Claude will locate timer or animation state and suggest isolating it.
